blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Diane Parry – Ningbo Open first round MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala regained her winning form after a dominant victory over France’s Diane Parry, 6-3, 6-1, in the Ningbo Open first round on Monday night in China. Eala claimed her first win in the Asian swing of the WTA Tour after opening-match losses to unseeded Russian Tatiana Prozorova at the Singapore Open and Chinese qualifier Shi Han in Wuhan on Tuesday. “I’m very happy with my performance. I think it was a really good, tough first round,” Eala said. READ: EJ Obiena sticks up for under-fire Alex Eala “Diane’s […]...
